newsitem.title: USA: Innovo says investor group to take 7.5 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Innovo says investor group to take 7.5 pct stake.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc said Wednesday an outside investor group has signed a letter of intent to take a 7.5 percent stake in the company.
The group led by investor L.E. Smith intends to infuse capital and its members will join the Innovo management and board, the company said.
Terms of the proposed investment by the group were not disclosed.
Innovo, a maker of fashion utility totes and bags, said that when the deal goes through, Smith will become chairman of the board and chief executive officer.
It said Patricia Anderson-Lasko, the current CEO, will remain president and will be in charge of domestic and international sales and marketing.
Two other members of the investor group, Dan Page and Erick Hendrickson, will also take up senior executive positions, it said.
Page will become vice president and chief operating oficer directly responsible for manufacturing while Hendrickson will become vice president and treasurer, it said.
Innovo said that among the first priorities of the group is initiating asset-based financing that aims to reduce financial-related expenses and improve operating results.
